# Nathaniel Nikolai Ladero Portfolio

Terminal-themed portfolio for Nathaniel Nikolai Ladero, a backend developer with
3 years building secure fintech systems in C# and ASP.NET Core. The site is a
page-per-viewport single-page app rendered as a terminal interface: each route
is one full page with keyboard-driven navigation, and the chrome is persistent.

## Owner

- Name: Nathaniel Nikolai Ladero
- Role: Backend Developer
- Focus: C#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, microservices, and fintech systems
- Experience: Backend Developer at Xentra Infotech Solutions Inc. (Mar 2023 to May 2026, remote)
- Email: nathanielnikolai.ladero@gmail.com

## What the portfolio contains

- Experience log: ASP.NET Web APIs, gRPC, SignalR, and RabbitMQ; a payments
  latency migration (MySql.Data to MySqlConnector on AWS) that cut worst-case
  query time from about 60s to under 1s; auth hardening (JWT, OAuth 2.0, OpenID
  Connect, RBAC, ABAC) with zero high or critical Snyk findings; and EF Core,
  Dapper, and Redis data access that cut read latency by over 40%.
- Skills: C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET, MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, AWS, Docker, GitHub
  Actions, Linux and Nginx, security and auth, testing, and AI-assisted
  development.
- Projects: Payments Latency Migration, Fintech Service Platform (1,182 commits
  across 17 repositories), Auth Hardening, and Read Cache Data Layer.
- Credentials: Google IT Automation with Python, Google IT Support, API Security
  Fundamentals, and OWASP API Security Top 10.
